│  **1. Where untrusted data first enters the code**                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  | # | Function / line | Source of the data (what can be attacker‑controlled) | Why it is the entry point |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            │
│  |---|----------------|------------------------------------------------------|---------------------------|                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             │
│  | 1️⃣ | `DocumentQueryHelper.__call__` / `DocumentQueryHelper.document_get_content(self, document, scheme)` | *`document`* can be supplied by an API call (URL string, file‑system path, or path to a remote resource). The **`scheme`** string is extracted from the supplied URL; the caller decides both values. | This is the top‑level handler    │
│  that decides how the document is fetched, parsed and indexed. Any attacker‑controlled document will end up here. |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│  | 2️⃣ | `handle_html_document`, `handle_text_document`, `handle_pdf_document`, `handle_unstructured_document`, `handle_image_document` | URLs or local file paths passed to the loader objects (`AsyncHtmlLoader`, `UnstructuredURLLoader`, `PyMuPDFLoader`, …). | These loaders will open network connections, read from the file system and feed     │
│  the raw byte/string data to the downstream OCR / parsing code. An attacker can control the URL or path string. |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      │
│  | 3️⃣ | **`AsyncHtmlLoader(web_path=document)`** (used for both `http` and `file` URLs) | `web_path` can be any string – e.g. `http://evil/internal/admin`. | This loader makes an async fetch of the supplied URL, potentially opening internal services (SSRF) or reading arbitrary local resources if the file‑scheme is abused. |                  │
│  | 4️⃣ | **`requests.get(document, timeout=10.0)`** in `handle_pdf_document` (fallback for HTTP PDFs) | Same as above – a user‑supplied URL is fetched. | Direct network call; opens the door to SSRF, credential leakage, and content‑type hijacking. |                                                                                                │
│  | 5️⃣ | **`tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(delete=False, suffix=ext)`** in both the file‑ and HTTP‑based document handlers | The attacker controls the *extension* (`ext`) and the *content* that is written into the temporary file (e.g. by influencing the URL that is later downloaded by `requests.get`). | Temporary files are later opened by       │
│  powerful parsers (PyMuPDF, OCR). If the file name or content can be chosen by the attacker, you risk *file‑system race* or *file‑upload* attacks. |                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│  | 6️⃣ | **`async with self.store_lock: success, ids = await self.store.add_document(document_content, document_uri_norm)`** | `document_content` is the *raw text* that may contain malicious payloads (e.g. malformed JSON, embedded scripts, shell commands). | The store may index the content into a vector DB or filesystem; the downstream       │
│  consumer may treat it as trusted. This is a **trust‑boundary crossing** from untrusted data to a “trusted” data store. |                                                                                                                                                                                                                              │
│  | 7️⃣ | **`pytesseract.image_to_string(page)`** used in the PDF → image → OCR fallback | The *image object* (`page`) is created from the temporary PDF pages that the attacker indirectly supplied via the original PDF document. | `pytesseract` invokes the external `tesseract` binary. Although the command is static, the **content of the        │
│  image** can trigger bugs in `tesseract` or cause denial‑of‑service, and the OCR output is later trusted as “document text”. |                                                                                                                                                                                                                         │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  ---                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  **2. High‑risk sinks that need immediate inspection**                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  | # | Sink (call) | What it does with the supplied data | Why it is dangerous |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
│  |---|--------------|--------------------------------------|----------------------|                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│  | A | `AsyncHtmlLoader(...).load()` | Opens a network connection (or a local file) and returns raw HTML / text. | Potential *Server‑Side Request Forgery* (SSRF) and *file‑read* by pointing `web_path` to `file://` URLs. |                                                                                                                          │
│  | B | `requests.get(document)` | Downloads arbitrary remote resources to a temporary file. | SSRF, content‑type confusion, zip‑bomb, and writing large payloads to disk without size limit checks. |                                                                                                                                                  │
│  | C | `PyMuPDFLoader(temp_file_path).load()` | Parses the binary PDF and extracts text and images. | If the PDF contains crafted objects it can trigger *memory corruption* or *code execution* inside MuPDF (C library). |                                                                                                                           │
│  | D | `pytesseract.image_to_string(page)` | Executes the system command `tesseract <temp_image> -` (or via Python wrapper). | The external `tesseract` binary is a separate process; a malicious image or crafted PDF may cause it to crash or, in older versions, execute arbitrary commands via specially crafted glyph data. |                     │
│  | E | `self.store.add_document(document_content, …)` | Writes the parsed text into an indexed store (potentially a vector DB, an SQLite DB, or a remote service). | Directly ingesting untrusted text into a downstream system that will be served to users opens *SQL injection*, *XSS* (if the store returns the content to a web UI), or *remote   │
│  code execution* via vector‑store plugins. |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│  | F | `os.unlink(temp_file_path)` (cleanup) | Deletes a temporary file. If the file name can be crafted (e.g. symlink to `/etc/passwd`), deletion may be prevented or mis‑behave. | Race condition / TOCTOU (time‑of‑check / time‑of‑use) on delete, leading to *file‑system privilege escalation*. |                                                 │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  ---                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  **3. Trust‑boundary crossings**                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  1. **Network ↔ Local file system ⇢ OCR / PDF parser**                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│     *Untrusted network data* (HTML, PDF, image) is read into RAM, written to a temporary file on disk, then handed to a third‑party C library. The boundary is weak because the library runs with the same privileges as the Process; any bug in the library is effectively an *on‑disk* *file‑inclusion* vector.                                      │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  2. **Raw text ↔ Vector / DB store**                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│     The parsed text is inserted into a store that may later be queried by a user‑facing API. If the store returns the raw content (e.g., in a chatbot answer) the previously injected payload may be rendered unescaped → **XSS** or **SQL i**njection depending on downstream layers.                                                                 │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  3. **File‑system ↔ Vector store**                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     │
│     Temporary PDF/image files are created and deleted *after* the parser. A compromised temporary file could persist long enough (due to race conditions) to be read by other processes or left for the attacker to re‑use.                                                                                                                            │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  ---                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  **4. Security themes that emerge**                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  | Theme | Typical symptom / risk | Where to look |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│  |-------|------------------------|----------------|                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│  | **SSRF / Unrestricted URL fetching** | `web_path` can be any string; no whitelist of schemes or hostname checks. | `AsyncHtmlLoader`, `handle_pdf_document` (uses `requests.get`). |                                                                                                                                                                │
│  | **Path Traversal & Unbounded File Reads** | Path can be `../../etc/passwd` or `file:///c:/secret`. No validation on `document` when the scheme is `file`. | URL → `AsyncHtmlLoader` (file scheme handling), `path` handling in `handle_*` functions. |                                                                                              │
│  | **Improper Input Validation on Extensions** | `suffix=ext` is taken directly from the supplied filename without sanitisation. | Temporary file creation (`NamedTemporaryFile`). |                                                                                                                                                                   │
│  | **Insecure Temporary Files / TOCTOU** | `delete=False` + later `os.unlink` after processing; race window allows symlink swap. | Creation of the temp file for PDF → image → OCR. |                                                                                                                                                                  │
│  | **Unsafe External Binary (OCR)** | `pytesseract.image_to_string` calls the external `tesseract` binary. Older versions are vulnerable to *crash loops* or *command injection* via specially crafted images. | OCR fallback inside `handle_unstructured_document` / `handle_image_document`. |                                                       │
│  | **Remote Code Execution through PDF parsing** | Third‑party `PyMuPDF` may execute embedded JavaScript (if the C++ lib enables it). | `PyMuPDFLoader`. |                                                                                                                                                                                             │
│  | **Improper Error Handling / Information Leakage** | Stack traces from failed loads may be returned to the caller. | All exception blocks (not shown but often implicit). |                                                                                                                                                                          │
│  | **Untrusted Output Consumption** | The parsed `document_content` may be returned to callers without sanitisation. | Return values from `document_get_content`; downstream API not shown but could be used. |                                                                                                                                        │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  ---                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  **5. Prioritised investigation/triaging order**                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  1. **SSRF & URL‑fetching** –                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          │
│     *Question:* Does the system permit any Unicode string to become a `http/https` URL? Are DNS entries validated? Is there a network policy that restricts outbound traffic?                                                                                                                                                                          │
│     *Action:* Add a whitelist of acceptable schemes (`http`, `https` only), enforce a domain‑allowlist, and replace `requests.get` with a sandboxed fetcher that validates certificates and redirects.                                                                                                                                                 │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  2. **Path handling & File‑system exposure** –                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         │
│     *Question:* Can an attacker supply a `file://` URL that accesses arbitrary files? Are path components normalized before being opened?                                                                                                                                                                                                              │
│     *Action:* Disallow the `file` scheme or, at minimum, resolve the path and ensure it stays inside a dedicated “document‑store” directory. Use `pathlib.Path.resolve().is_relative_to(root_dir)` checks.                                                                                                                                             │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  3. **Temporary‑file security** –                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      │
│     *Question:* Is the temp file created with a predictable name? Does the attacker control the file’s *suffix* or *content*? Is there a risk of TOCTOU with the `unlink`?                                                                                                                                                                             │
│     *Action:* Use `tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(delete=True)` and set `suffix` to a random value that is *not* derived from user input. Perform a dedicated `os.open(..., os.O_EXCL)` to guarantee atomic creation. Cleanup must happen in a `finally` block and each process must check file ownership before deletion.                                │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  4. **OCR / third‑party native binary** –                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              │
│     *Question:* Which version of `tesseract` is installed? Are there known CVEs (e.g., `CVE‑2023‑XXXX`) affecting the version? Is the binary executed via a shell where environment variables could be abused?                                                                                                                                         │
│     *Action:* Pin Tesseract to a known‑good version, run it inside a constrained sandbox (e.g., `subprocess.run(..., check=True, stdout=PIPE, stderr=PIPE, env=restricted_env)`), and add a timeout. Consider using a pure‑Python OCR library (e.g., `kraken`) to eliminate the external dependency.                                                   │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  5. **PDF parsing safety** –                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│     *Question:* Does the application enable JavaScript execution within PDFs? Does the call to `PyMuPDFLogger` expose an API that can be abused to write files?                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│     *Action:* Force `document.open()` with `disable_encryption=True, render_limit=0` to limit the parser’s work; optionally validate the PDF with a tool like `pdfid` to detect JavaScript before passing it to MuPDF.                                                                                                                                 │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  6. **Vector store / downstream trust** –                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              │
│     *Question:* What exactly does `self.store` do with `document_content`? Is it stored in a persistent DB, a remote service, or a local file? Are there any injection vectors later when the stored text is deserialized?                                                                                                                             │
│     *Action:* Treat the content as *untrusted*; do not feed it directly into a SQL query or JSON response. Encode / escape before transmission. Log the content length and type for anomaly detection.                                                                                                                                                 │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  7. **Error handling & logging** –                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     │
│     *Question:* Are any exceptions caught and sent back to the API client? Do they leak internal paths, file names or stack traces?                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│     *Action:* Return generic error messages; log internal details to a secure log file with limited retention.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  ---                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  **6. What to ask (or have the owner answer) to move forward**                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  1. **Input validation** – What checks are performed before a `document` string is accepted? Is there a whitelist for `scheme` (`http`, `https`, `file`) and for the hostname?                                                                                                                                                                         │
│  2. **Allowed file extensions** – When a user uploads a PDF that is later processed, do we trust the extension alone? Is there a separate “signature” check?                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│  3. **Temporary‑file policy** – Are temporary files created with a `suffix` that the attacker controls? Is the deletion performed in the same process that created the file?                                                                                                                                                                           │
│  4. **Third‑party version pinning** – Which exact versions of `requests`, `PyMuPDF`, `pytesseract`, and `tesseract` are running in production? Are they updated regularly?                                                                                                                                                                             │
│  5. **Network policies** – Are outbound HTTP connections from this process allowed only to specific internal domains?                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  │
│  6. **Persistence of the vector store** – Is the index stored locally (e.g., SQLite) or in a shared service? Can the stored documents be retrieved directly by a user?                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│  7. **Sandboxing** – Is the entire processing path (loading, parsing, OCR) already executed inside a Kubernetes pod with strict Resource Limits and a read‑only root filesystem? If not, why not?                                                                                                                                                      │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  The answers will allow you to confirm whether the *high‑risk bugs* (SSRF, path traversal, unsafe OCR) are mitigated or still exploitable.                                                                                                                                                                                                             │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  ---                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  ### TL;DR                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  *The biggest attack surface is the *unrestricted handling of external URLs and local paths* that leads to network fetches, file reads, and feeding of that data into powerful but native parsers (PyMuPDF, Tesseract). Secure the incoming URL/path, eliminate the `file://` or `http://` fallback unless you have very tight whitelisting, and wrap  │
│  the whole processing in a sandbox that prevents the external native binaries from touching the host file system or external services. Prioritise SSRF/URL‑validation first, then temp‑file handling, then OCR PDF parser safety, then the downstream store.* This systematic list of entry points, sinks, boundaries, and themes should give you a    │
│  concrete checklist for a security review.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │

│          """                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│          Normalize a document URI to ensure consistent lookup.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│          Args:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         │
│              uri: The URI to normalize                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │

│          scheme = parsed.scheme or "file"                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              │

│                  normalized.removeprefix("file://").removeprefix("file:")                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              │
│              )                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         │
│              normalized = f"file://{path}"                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│          elif scheme in ["http", "https"]:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             │
│              # Always use https for web URLs                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│              normalized = normalized.replace("http://", "https://")                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│          return normalized                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             │

│      async def add_document(                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │

│          """                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│          # Normalize the URI                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│          document_uri = self.normalize_uri(document_uri)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│          # Delete existing document if it exists to avoid duplicates                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │

│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│          # Split text into chunks                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      │
│          text_splitter = RecursiveCharacterTextSplitter(                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│              chunk_size=self.DEFAULT_CHUNK_SIZE, chunk_overlap=self.DEFAULT_CHUNK_OVERLAP                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              │
│          )                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             │
│          chunks = text_splitter.split_text(text)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│          # Create documents                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            │
│          docs = []                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     │
│          for i, chunk in enumerate(chunks):                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            │
│              chunk_metadata = doc_metadata.copy()                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      │
│              chunk_metadata["chunk_index"] = i                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         │
│              chunk_metadata["total_chunks"] = len(chunks)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              │
│              docs.append(Document(page_content=chunk, metadata=chunk_metadata))                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │

│          if not docs:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  │
│              PrintStyle.error(f"No chunks created for document: {document_uri}")                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
│              return False, []                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│          try:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          │
│              # Initialize vector db if not already initialized                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         │
│              if not self.vector_db:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │

│              PrintStyle.standard(                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      │
│                  f"Added document '{document_uri}' with {len(docs)} chunks"                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            │
│              )                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         │
│              return True, ids                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          │
│          except Exception as e:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│              err_text = errors.format_error(e)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         │
│              PrintStyle.error(f"Error adding document '{document_uri}': {err_text}")                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│              return False, []                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          │

│      async def get_document(self, document_uri: str) -> Optional[Document]:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            │
│          """                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│          Retrieve a document by its URI.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │

│          metadata = chunks[0].metadata.copy()                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          │
│          metadata.pop("chunk_index", None)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             │
│          metadata.pop("total_chunks", None)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│          return Document(page_content=full_content, metadata=metadata)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │

│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │

│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │

│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│      async def document_exists(self, document_uri: str) -> bool:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
│          """                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│          Check if a document exists in the store.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│          Args:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         │

│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │

│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│          # DB not initialized, no documents inside                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     │
│          if not self.vector_db:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│              return False                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│          # Normalize the URI                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│          document_uri = self.normalize_uri(document_uri)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│          chunks = await self._get_document_chunks(document_uri)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│          return len(chunks) > 0                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│      async def delete_document(self, document_uri: str) -> bool:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
│          """                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│          Delete a document from the store.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│          Args:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         │
│              document_uri: The URI of the document to delete                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│          Returns:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      │
│              True if deleted, False if not found                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
│          """                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│          # DB not initialized, no documents inside                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     │
│          if not self.vector_db:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│              return False                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│          # Normalize the URI                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│          document_uri = self.normalize_uri(document_uri)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│          chunks = await self.vector_db.search_by_metadata(                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             │
│              filter=f"document_uri == '{document_uri}'",                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│          )                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             │
│          if not chunks:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                │
│              return False                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│          # Collect IDs to delete                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
│          ids_to_delete = [chunk.metadata["id"] for chunk in chunks]                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│          # Delete from vector store                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│          if ids_to_delete:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             │
│              dels = await self.vector_db.delete_documents_by_ids(ids_to_delete)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│              PrintStyle.standard(                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      │
│                  f"Deleted document '{document_uri}' with {len(dels)} chunks"                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          │
│              )                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         │
│              return True                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│          return False                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
