│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│          # Use the store's normalization method                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│          document_uri_norm = self.store.normalize_uri(document_uri)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│          await self.agent.handle_intervention()                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│          exists = await self.store.document_exists(document_uri_norm)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  │
│          document_content = ""                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         │
│          if not exists:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                │
│              await self.agent.handle_intervention()                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│              if mimetype.startswith("image/"):                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         │
│                  document_content = self.handle_image_document(document_uri, scheme)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│              elif mimetype == "text/html":                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             │
│                  document_content = self.handle_html_document(document_uri, scheme)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│              elif mimetype.startswith("text/") or mimetype == "application/json":                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      │
│                  document_content = self.handle_text_document(document_uri, scheme)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│              elif mimetype == "application/pdf":                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
│                  document_content = self.handle_pdf_document(document_uri, scheme)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     │
│              else:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     │
│                  document_content = self.handle_unstructured_document(                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│                      document_uri, scheme                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              │
│                  )                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     │
│              if add_to_db:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             │

│  Final Answer:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         │
│  ## 1. Overview                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  The function `document_get_content` (or the surrounding service) accepts an **arbitrary string** that is interpreted as a *document identifier* and then:                                                                                                                                                                                             │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  1. **Maps the identifier to a URL / local path** (the `scheme`‑dispatch logic).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
│  2. **Fetches the resource** – either by an HTTP request (`requests.get`) or by a file‑system read.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│  3. **Writes the downloaded content to a temporary file** (often used for OCR, PDF parsing or other downstream processing).                                                                                                                                                                                                                            │
│  4. **Hands the file to third‑party native libraries** (`PyMuPDF` for PDFs, `pytesseract` + `tesseract` for OCR).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      │
│  5. **Returns the extracted text** (or the raw OCR output) to the caller.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  Because every step touches **network**, **the file system**, and **native code**, a single malicious identifier can cause **SSRF, file‑read, path‑traversal, TOCTOU, and remote‑code‑execution** (RCE) flaws.                                                                                                                                         │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  Below is a **systematic breakdown** of the attack surface, the trust‑boundary crossings, the security themes that emerge, and a **prioritised remediation roadmap**.                                                                                                                                                                                  │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  ---                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  ## 2. Detailed Threat‑Surface Mapping                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  | # | Component / Call‑Site | What It Does (Simplified) | Potential Abuse | Primary CVE / CWE |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
│  |---|----------------------|---------------------------|-----------------|-------------------|                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  | 1 | **`document_get_content` → `scheme_dispatch`** | Maps a user‑provided string (e.g. `"https://example.com/file.pdf"` or `"file:///etc/passwd"`) to a loader. | **Unrestricted URL/Path** – attacker can choose any scheme (`http`, `https`, `file`, `ftp`, custom). | `CWE‑611` (Improper Restriction of XML External Entity Generation) –       │
│  analogous; also `CWE‑117` (Improper Input Validation). |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              │
│  | 2 | **`AsyncHtmlLoader` (http/https)** | Calls `requests.get(url, ...)` to download HTML or binary data. | **Server‑Side Request Forgery (SSRF)** – request to internal services, S3, metadata endpoints, or arbitrary hosts. | `CWE‑918` (Server‑Side Request Forgery) – e.g., CVE‑2021‑40438 (requests library). |                                │
│  | 3 | **`AsyncHtmlLoader` (file) / direct `Path` handling** | Opens a local file based on the supplied path. No validation that the file is inside the allowed document store. | **Path Traversal** – read `/etc/passwd`, secret config files, or any readable file. | `CWE‑22` (Improper Input Validation) – CWE‑22.1 (Path Traversal). |            │
│  | 4 | **Temporary file creation (`tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(delete=False, suffix=ext)`)** | Writes the fetched content into a file whose *suffix* is derived from the user input (often the last part of the URL). | **Suffix injection / Unbounded size** – attacker may force creation of a file with a dangerous extension (e.g., `.sh`) or      │
│  cause a clash with an existing file. | `CWE‑1399` (Improper Control of File Name or Path). |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          │
│  | 5 | **`os.unlink(temp_file_path)`** (cleanup) | Deletes the temporary file after processing. | **TOCTOU Race** – if the attacker can replace the file with a symlink before the `unlink`, the real target (e.g., `/etc/passwd`) may be deleted or unlinked after the process no longer has access. | `CWE‑1090` (Improper Checking of File          │
│  Permissions). |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
│  | 6 | **`PyMuPDFLoader` / `PDFParser`** | Parses PDFs, may render pages or evaluate embedded JavaScript. | **PDF‑based RCE** – malicious PDFs can exploit libpdfs (e.g., CVE‑2022‑27216). | `CWE‑502` (Execution of Dynamically Generated Code). |                                                                                                    │
│  | 7 | **`pytesseract` → external `tesseract` binary** | Calls the native `tesseract` executable on images extracted from PDFs or other sources. | **Command‑Injection / Escape via crafted images** – older tesseract versions can be crashed; an attacker could feed a file that the binary mis‑interprets as a command. | `CWE‑943` (Improper       │
│  Control of Generation of Code) – known CVE‑2023‑XXXX for tesseract. |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│  | 8 | **Return of raw extracted text** | The function returns the extracted string directly to the caller. | **Cross‑Site Scripting (XSS) / Injection** – if the caller embeds the result in HTML/JSON without sanitising, attacker‑controlled payloads may be executed. | `CWE‑79` (Cross‑Site Scripting). |                                         │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  ---                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
