│  ## 3. Trust‑Boundary Crossings                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  | Boundary | Direction | Why It’s Dangerous | Mitigations (High‑Level) |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              │
│  |----------|-----------|--------------------|---------------------------|                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             │
│  | **Network ↔ Local File System** | Remote URL → Disk (temp file) | Data is processed by native libs that have the same OS permissions. | • Validate URLs before fetch (scheme whitelist, host allow‑list).<br>• Store temp files in a *dedicated* sandboxed directory with no access to privileged data.<br>• Run the entire loading/parsing in a    │
│  container with a read‑only root FS. |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│  | **File System ↔ OCR / PDF Native Lib** | Disk file → C library (PyMuPDF, tesseract) | Native libs can execute native instructions; any bug is an RCE vector. | • Pin library versions and run inside a hardened VM/pod.<br>• Disable PDF JavaScript (PyMuPDF: `document.setJavaScriptEnabled(False)`).<br>• Use pure‑Python OCR when possible. |    │
│  | **Extracted Text ↔ Vector / DB Store** | Raw text → Persistent store | Store may later be read and interpreted as code or data in other services. | • Treat all extracted text as **untrusted**; escape/encode before storing.<br>• Store metadata about source and a hash of the raw content for later integrity checks. |                         │
│  | **Temporary File ↔ Cleanup** | File created in Process A, deleted in Process B (if cleanup done by another thread/process) | TOCTOU: Process B can swap the file with a symlink before deletion. | • Delete the file with the exact same open file descriptor (passed from creation).<br>• Use `os.replace` + atomic `unlink` in a single           │
│  transaction, or simply set `delete=True` and let the context manager handle removal. |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  ---                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  ## 4. Security Themes (What to watch for)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  | Theme | Manifestation in this code | Typical CWE | Example Attack |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│  |-------|----------------------------|-------------|----------------|                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│  | **SSRF & Unrestricted URL Fetching** | All schemes accepted, no host validation. | CWE‑918, CWE‑22 | Fetch internal `http://127.0.0.1:3000/internal` or the metadata endpoint of the current EC2 instance. |                                                                                                                                        │
│  | **Path Traversal & File Disclosure** | Direct use of user‑provided string as a file path. | CWE‑22 | `"../../../../etc/passwd"` or `"file:///etc/nginx/conf.d/secret"` |                                                                                                                                                                            │
│  | **Unsafe Temporary‑File Creation** | `suffix=ext` derived from user, `delete=False`. | CWE‑1399, CWE‑434 (Unrestricted Upload of File With Dangerous Type) | Force a `.pdf` suffix to hide a malicious payload, later executed as a `.sh`. |                                                                                                        │
│  | **TOCTOU on Cleanup** | File unlink after processing, possible race. | CWE‑1090 | Replace `/tmp/tmp123.pdf` with a symlink to `/etc/shadow` → `unlink` removes the system file entry. |                                                                                                                                                             │
│  | **Improper External Binary Use (OCR)** | `pytesseract` calls the `tesseract` binary; no sandbox. | CWE‑943, CWE‑20 | Corrupt image leads to buffer‑overflow in tesseract, causing RCE. |                                                                                                                                                            │
│  | **Cross‑Site Scripting / Injection** | Raw text returned and rendered by caller. | CWE‑79 | Attacker sends a PDF that extracts `<script>alert(1)</script>`; the service returns the string directly in a `<div>`. |                                                                                                                                 │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  ---                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  ## 5. Remediation Roadmap (Prioritised by Likelihood & Impact)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  ### **1️⃣ Harden the Identifier → URL / Path Resolution (Immediate – < 1 day)**                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  * **Scheme whitelist** – only allow `http`, `https`, and *explicitly* file paths under a dedicated folder (e.g., `/app/documents/`). Reject everything else.                                                                                                                                                                                          │
│  * **Host allow‑list** – for HTTP/HTTPS URLs reject private IP ranges, `127.0.0.0/8`, `files.avamanager` metadata endpoints, and *any* string that contains `//` not preceded by a whitelisted scheme.                                                                                                                                                 │
│  * **Path sanitisation** – when a `file:` URL is used, resolve it with `pathlib.Path`, ensure it is inside the allowed directory with `Path.is_relative_to(ALLOWED_ROOT)`. Use `os.path.realpath` to eliminate symlinks.                                                                                                                               │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  ### **2️⃣ Network Request Hardening (1‑2 days)**                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
│  * Replace the current `requests.get` with a **session that has a timeout** and **connect/read limits** (e.g., `requests.adapters.HTTPAdapter(pool_conns, pool_maxsize)`).                                                                                                                                                                             │
│  * Use **`verify=True`** (default) and **certificate pinning** if possible.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            │
│  * Optionally, route all outbound requests through a **proxy** (e.g., `mitmproxy`) that can enforce URL policies.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  ### **3️⃣ Temporary‑File Controls (1 day)**                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            │
│  * **Never allow user‑controlled suffix**. Use a fixed temporary extension that matches the expected format (`".pdf"` for PDFs, `".png"` for OCR).                                                                                                                                                                                                     │
│  * Create the file with `tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(delete=True)` – let the context manager clean it up automatically.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                │
│  * **Set restrictive file permissions** (`0o600`) when the content may contain personal data.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  ### **4️⃣ TOCTOU & Cleanup (1 day)**                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│  * If you must delete after processing, **delete using the same file descriptor** that was written (store it before closing).                                                                                                                                                                                                                          │
│  * Or, **move the temp file out of the directory** after creation and give it an absolute path that you control; then delete it with `os.unlink` *immediately* before any other code runs.                                                                                                                                                             │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  ### **5️⃣ PDF & OCR Hardening (3‑5 days)**                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  | Action | Rationale | How |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          │
│  |--------|-----------|-----|                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          │
│  | **Disable PDF JavaScript** | Prevents PDF‑based RCE from embedded scripts. | ```python\nfrom fitz import Document\nwith Document(path) as doc: doc.set_JavaScript_enabled(False)\n``` |                                                                                                                                                             │
│  | **Upgrade / Patch libraries** | Recent CVEs (CVE‑2022‑27216 for MuPDF) have been fixed. | Pin to the latest version, run `mypip freeze > requirements.txt`. |                                                                                                                                                                                       │
│  | **Run PDF parsing in an isolated sandbox** | Even patched libs can have unknown bugs. | Use a separate process that lives inside a Docker container with `--cap-drop=ALL` and a memory limit. |                                                                                                                                                     │
│  | **Prefer pure‑Python OCR or a vetted sandboxed service** | Removes native dependencies. | `pytesseract` → `easyocr` or `pdfplumber` for text extraction, or off‑load OCR to a separate micro‑service that lives in a separate VPC network zone. |                                                                                                   │
│  | **Apply image sanitisation before OCR** | Strip EXIF, limit dimensions, convert to PNG, and drop any alpha channel that might be mis‑interpreted. | Use `Pillow` to open the image, enforce max size (e.g., `MAX_DIM = 2000`), and save as a clean PNG. |                                                                                           │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  ### **6️⃣ Text Output Sanitisation (Immediate – 1 day)**                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│  * Escape any special HTML sequences before returning **HTML** responses.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              │
│  * If the caller uses the text in **JSON** or **XML**, ensure proper quoting.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          │
│  * Consider returning a **structured result** with a separate “raw” and “safe” version.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  ### **7️⃣ Logging, Auditing & Rate‑Limiting (Ongoing)**                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                │
│  * Log **every identifier** and the resolved URL/path. Include a cryptographic hash (e.g., SHA‑256) of the fetched content.                                                                                                                                                                                                                            │
│  * Enable **rate‑limits per user / IP** to mitigate enumeration attacks.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│  * Use **WAF** rules that block known SSRF patterns (`169.254.in‑addr.arp`, `/host=`, `/metadata/`).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  ---                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  ## 6. Suggested Code Skeleton (Minimal, Secure Version)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  ```python                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             │
│  from pathlib import Path                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              │
│  import tempfile                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
│  import requests                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
│  import hashlib                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  from typing import Tuple                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              │
│  from pdfminer.high_level import extract_text  # pure‑Python PDF parser                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                │
│  from PIL import Image                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│  import io                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  ALLOWED_ROOT = Path("/app/documents").resolve()                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
│  ALLOWED_HOSTS = {"docs.example.com"}      # whitelist only                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            │
│  TEMP_MAX_SIZE = 50 * 1024 * 1024          # 50 MiB                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  def _resolve_file_url(url: str) -> Path:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              │
│      """Validate that `url` points to a file inside ALLOWED_ROOT."""                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│      if not url.lower().startswith("file://"):                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         │
│          raise ValueError("Only file:// URLs are allowed for local files.")                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            │
│      raw = url[7:]          # strip "file://"                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          │
│      path = Path(raw).resolve()                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│      # prevent symlink tricks: ensure realpath still inside ALLOWED_ROOT                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│      try:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              │
│          path.relative_to(ALLOWED_ROOT)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                │
│      except ValueError:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                │
│          raise PermissionError(f"File {url} resolves outside allowed directory.")                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      │
│      if not path.is_file():                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            │
│          raise FileNotFoundError(url)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  │
│      return path                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  def _download(url: str) -> Tuple[bytes, str]:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         │
│      """Download via HTTP/HTTPS, respecting the host whitelist."""                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     │
│      # --- URL parsing -------------------------------------------------                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│      import urllib.parse                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│      pars = urllib.parse.urlparse(url)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│      if pars.scheme not in {"http", "https"}:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          │
│          raise PermissionError(f"Unsupported URL scheme: {pars.scheme}")                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│      host = pars.hostname or ""                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│      if host not in ALLOWED_HOSTS:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     │
│          raise PermissionError(f"Host {host} not allowed.")                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            │
│      # --- Fetch -------------------------------------------------------                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│      resp = requests.get(url, timeout=10, stream=True)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│      resp.raise_for_status()                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│      data = b"".join(iter(lambda: resp.raw.read(8192), b""))                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│      if len(data) > TEMP_MAX_SIZE:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     │
│          raise ValueError("Payload exceeds allowed size limit.")                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
│      return data, resp.headers.get("Content-Type", "")                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  def extract_text_from_bytes(content: bytes, mime: str) -> str:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│      """Dispatch to pure‑Python or safe native parser."""                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              │
│      if "pdf" in mime.lower():                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         │
│          # Use pdfminer, which is pure Python (no native libs)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         │
│          return extract_text(io.BytesIO(content))                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      │
│      elif mime.lower() in {"image", "jpeg", "png"}:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│          # OCR via a sandboxed service – here we just demonstrate a safe path                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          │
│          img = Image.open(io.BytesIO(content)).convert("RGB")                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          │
│          # optionally resize / strip EXIF                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              │
│          img.thumbnail((2000, 2000), Image.ANTIALIAS)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  │
│          return my_ocr_service.send(img)   # the OCR service runs in its own container                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│      else:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             │
│          raise ValueError("Unsupported MIME type for extraction.")                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  def process_document(id: str) -> str:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│      """                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│      Central entry point – the `id` may be a document name or a full URL.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              │
│      """                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│      # 1️⃣ Resolve to a concrete resource                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│      if id.startswith("http://") or id.startswith("https://"):                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         │
│          resource = id                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│          data, mime = _download(resource)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              │
│      elif id.startswith("file:///"):                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│          path = _resolve_file_url(id)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  │
│          data = path.read_bytes()                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      │
│          mime = "application/pdf" if path.suffix.lower() == ".pdf" else "application/octet-stream"                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     │
│      else:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             │
│          raise ValueError("URI scheme not recognised.")                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│      # 2️⃣ Extract text in a pure‑Python way                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            │
│      return extract_text_from_bytes(data, mime)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  # -----------------------------------------------------------------------                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             │
│  # Example usage – keep this in a sandboxed process!                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│  if __name__ == "__main__":                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            │
│      import sys                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│      print(process_document(sys.argv[1]))                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              │
│  ```                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  **Key safety points demonstrated**                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  * **Scheme / host / path validation** is strictly enforced.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│  * **No user‑controlled temporary file** – we keep everything in memory or in a read‑only file that we never modify.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│  * **Pure‑Python parsers** (`pdfminer`, Pillow) are used, avoiding native libraries.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│  * **Limits**: request timeout, payload size, image thumbnail size.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│  * **Separation of concerns**: the OCR call is delegated to an *independent* service that can be deployed with a deeper security perimeter.                                                                                                                                                                                                            │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  ---                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  ## 7. Closing Remarks                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  * The **most exploitable surface** today is the *dynamic parsing of whatever the attacker can make the system fetch* (PDF → OCR → text). Hardening the *fetch* and *parse* phases in a *defence‑in‑depth* manner dramatically reduces the attack surface.                                                                                             │
│  * Even after applying the above fixes, **continuous security testing** (static analysis of the library versions, fuzzing the PDF parser, integration tests with malicious documents) is essential.                                                                                                                                                    │
│  * Document the **security assumptions** (e.g., “only `pdfminer` is used → native‑code RCE is impossible”) and embed those in the code repository’s README so future contributors keep the same mental model.                                                                                                                                          │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  By applying the fixes in the order shown, you will move the service from a *potentially vulnerable* “fetch‑anything‑parse‑anything” state to a *defence‑in‑depth* configuration that is resilient to both opportunistic SSRF attacks and targeted document‑exploitation attempts.                                                                     │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │

│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  class DocumentQueryStore:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             │
│      """                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│      FAISS Store for document query results.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│      Manages documents identified by URI for storage, retrieval, and searching.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│      """                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│      # Default chunking parameters                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     │
│      DEFAULT_CHUNK_SIZE = 1000                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         │
│      DEFAULT_CHUNK_OVERLAP = 100                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│      # Cache for initialized stores                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│      _stores: dict[str, "DocumentQueryStore"] = {}                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│      @staticmethod                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     │
│      def get(agent: Agent):                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            │
│          """Create a DocumentQueryStore instance for the specified agent."""                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│          if not agent or not agent.config:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             │
│              raise ValueError("Agent and agent config must be provided")                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│          # Initialize store                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            │
│          store = DocumentQueryStore(agent)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             │
│          return store                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│      def __init__(                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     │
│          self,                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         │
│          agent: Agent,                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│      ):                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                │
│          """Initialize a DocumentQueryStore instance."""                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│          self.agent = agent                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            │
│          self.vector_db: VectorDB | None = None                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│      @staticmethod                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     │
│      def normalize_uri(uri: str) -> str:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│          """                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│          Normalize a document URI to ensure consistent lookup.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│          Args:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         │
│              uri: The URI to normalize                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│          Returns:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      │
│              Normalized URI                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            │
│          """                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│          # Convert to lowercase                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│          normalized = uri.strip()  # uri.lower()                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│          # Parse the URL to get scheme                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│          parsed = urlparse(normalized)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│          scheme = parsed.scheme or "file"                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              │
