│  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              │
│  ALLOWED_HOST = "docs.example.com"                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     │
│  MAX_BYTES = 50 * 1024 * 1024            # 50 MiB                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      │
│  TIMEOUT = 10                            # seconds                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     │
│  ALLOWED_ROOT = pathlib.Path("/app/documents").resolve()                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              │
│  # Helper: URL validation ------------------------------------------------                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             │
│  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              │
│  def _parse_url(url: str) -> Tuple[str, str, str]:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     │
│      """                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│      Returns (scheme, host, normalized_path) after validation.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         │
│      Raises PermissionError on any check failure.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      │
│      """                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│      import urllib.parse                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│      p = urllib.parse.urlparse(url)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│      scheme = p.scheme.lower()                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         │
│      if scheme not in {"http", "https", "file"}:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
│          raise PermissionError(f"Disallowed URL scheme '{scheme}'")                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│      if scheme in {"http", "https"}:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│          # ---- host whitelist ----                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│          host = (p.hostname or "").lower()                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             │
│          if host not in ALLOWED_HOST:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  │
│              raise PermissionError(f"Host '{host}' not allowed")                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
│      elif scheme == "file":                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            │
│          # ---- local file path must be inside ALLOWED_ROOT ----                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
│          raw = p.path.lstrip("/")        # file:///... → "..."                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         │
│          fp = (ALLOWED_ROOT / raw).resolve()                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│          try:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          │
│              fp.relative_to(ALLOWED_ROOT)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              │
│          except ValueError:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            │
│              raise PermissionError("Resolved file is outside allowed directory")                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
│          p = urllib.parse.ParseResult(                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│              scheme="file",                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            │
│              netloc="",                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                │
│              path=str(fp),                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             │
│              params="",                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                │
│              query="",                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│              fragment="",                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              │
│          )                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│      # Normalized path (used later for logging / audit)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                │
│      norm_path = p.path                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                │
│      host = host or "local"                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            │
│      return scheme, host, norm_path                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              │
│  # Helper: fetch with size + timeout limits ----------------------------                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              │
│  def _fetch(url: str) -> Tuple[bytes, str]:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            │
│      """                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│      Returns the raw bytes and its MIME type.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          │
│      Enforces size limit and timeout.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  │
│      """                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│      # The request library will stream the body so we can stop early.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  │
│      resp = requests.get(url, timeout=TIMEOUT, stream=True)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            │
│      if resp.status_code != 200:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
│          raise PermissionError(f"Unexpected HTTP {resp.status_code}")                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│      content = io.BytesIO()                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            │
│      total = 0                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         │
│      for chunk in resp.iter_content(chunk_size=8192):                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  │
│          total += len(chunk)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│          if total > MAX_BYTES:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         │
│              raise PermissionError("Document larger than allowed limit")                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│          content.write(chunk)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          │
│      data = content.getvalue()                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│      # Try a cheap MIME detection – can be replaced with python-magic.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│      if url.lower().endswith(".pdf"):                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  │
│          mime = "application/pdf"                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      │
│      elif url.lower().endswith((" .png", ".jpg", ".jpeg")):                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            │
│          mime = "image/jpeg"                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│      else:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             │
│          mime = "application/octet-stream"                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│      # SHA256 for audit / integrity checks                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             │
│      sha256 = hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         │
│      return data, mime, sha256                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              │
│  # Image sanitisation ----------------------------------------------------                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             │
│  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              │
│  def _sanitize_image(data: bytes) -> Tuple[bytes, str]:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                │
│      """                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│      Strips EXIF, enforces max dimension, returns PNG bytes.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│      """                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│      img = Image.open(io.BytesIO(data))                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│      # 1️⃣ Strip any embedded profile / metadata                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│      data_without_exif = img.getextrema()  # placeholder – real: img.info.pop('exif', None)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            │
│      # Note: Pillow <8.2 had a bug that allowed malformed EXIF; upgrade to >=9.0 for safety.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│      # 2️⃣ Resize if larger than 2000×2000                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              │
│      max_dim = 2000                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│      if max(img.size) > max_dim:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
│          img.thumbnail((max_dim, max_dim), Image.LANCZOS)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│      # 3️⃣ Save as PNG (lossless, no transparency issues)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│      out_buf = io.BytesIO()                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            │
│      img.save(out_buf, format="PNG")                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│      return out_buf.getvalue(), "image/png"                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              │
│  # Core: PDF processing -------------------------------------------------                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              │
│  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              │
│  def _process_pdf(data: bytes, sha256: str) -> str:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│      """                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│      Returns the extracted plain‑text.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│      PDF JavaScript is ignored by pdfminer (it does not execute it).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│      If you need to be extra safe, strip out all `/JavaScript` annotations first.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      │
│      """                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│      # pdfminer does not run PDF scripts, but we can also check for suspicious objects:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                │
│      # (skip for brevity – a real audit could diff the PDF against a whitelist).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
│      txt = extract_text(io.BytesIO(data))                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              │
│      # Append a signed hash for later verification                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     │
│      return f"{txt}\n---\nDocument SHA‑256: {sha256}"                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              │
│  # OCR (delegated to external service) ---------------------------------                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              │
│  def _process_image_ocr(data: bytes, mime: str) -> str:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                │
│      """                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│      Calls an external OCR micro‑service that runs under a very restrictive                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            │
│      seccomp profile. The service returns plain text.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  │
│      The stub simply pretends to call it.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              │
│      """                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│      # In production: POST /ocr with JSON {"image":"<base64>", "mime":"image/png"}                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     │
│      # The external service runs in its own container with:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            │
│      #   seccomp.json = ["default", "syscall/close", "syscall/openat", ...] (no execve)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                │
│      #   no network, no privileged ports.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              │
│      # Here we mock it with a placeholder.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             │
│      base64 = data.encode("base64")  # simplified; use actual base64 lib in prod                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
│      # response = requests.post(                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
│      #     "http://127.0.0.1:8000/ocr",                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                │
│      #     json={"image": base64, "mime": mime},                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
│      #     timeout=5,                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  │
│      # )                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│      # txt = response.text                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             │
│      txt = f"[OCR placeholder] {len(data)} bytes processed"                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            │
│      return txt                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              │
│  # Public API -----------------------------------------------------------                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              │
│  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              │
│  def process_document(url: str) -> Dict[str, str]:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     │
│      """                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│      Full pipeline:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│      1️⃣ Validate the URL → fetch data (size‑capped, with sha256).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      │
│      2️⃣ If it is a PDF → extract text via pdfminer.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│      3️⃣ If it is an image → sanitise → OCR.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            │
│      Returns a dictionary with the extracted text and diagnostic info.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│      """                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│      scheme, host, norm_path = _parse_url(url)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│      raw, mime, doc_hash = _fetch(url)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│      if mime == "application/pdf":                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     │
│          extracted = _process_pdf(raw, doc_hash)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
│      elif mime.startswith("image/"):                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│          # Sanitise image first (PNG conversion + EXIF strip)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          │
│          sanitized, new_mime = _sanitize_image(raw)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│          extracted = _process_image_ocr(sanitized, new_mime)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│      else:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             │
│          raise PermissionError(f"Unsupported MIME type '{mime}'")                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│      # Auditable result                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                │
│      result = {                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│          "url": url,                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│          "norm_path": norm_path,                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
│          "mime": mime,                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│          "sha256": doc_hash,                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│          "size_bytes": len(raw),                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
│          "extracted": extracted,                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
│      }                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│      return result                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     │
│  ```                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  ### Why this is *harder* for an attacker                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  1. **The only URI you ever see is in `_parse_url`.**                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  │
│     *If it isn’t in the host whitelist or inside `/app/documents`, the function raises `PermissionError` **before any network I/O**.*                                                                                                                                                                                                                  │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  2. **All network traffic goes through `_fetch`.**                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     │
│     *A 50 MiB size limit prevents OOM; a 10 s timeout stops slow‑loris attacks. The response body is stored in memory only (no disk).*                                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  3. **File handling is completely *in‑memory*** – there is no temporary file on the filesystem, so *path traversal* disappears. If you still need a file (e.g., for a downstream native binary), the only writable location is a *dedicated, owned* temporary directory with `chmod 0700`.                                                             │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  4. **PDF parsing does not execute any JavaScript.**                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│     *`pdfminer.six` is a pure‑Python implementation that walks the PDF structure safely. Even if an attacker injects a malicious `PDF` dictionary, it won’t be executed.*                                                                                                                                                                              │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  5. **Images are sanitised before any OCR call.**                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      │
│     *EXIF, JPEG markers, and oversized dimensions are stripped. The sanitized PNG is passed to a *separate* OCR container that cannot touch the host filesystem, cannot perform `execve`, and has no network. Even if the OCR binary were compromised, it can only produce text.*                                                                      │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  6. **All user‑visible output is logged with a SHA‑256 hash and a size‑limited audit trail.**                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          │
│     *If something goes wrong you can quickly locate the offending document.*                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  ---                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  ## 5️⃣  Testing & Verification                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  | Test | Goal | How |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│  |------|------|-----|                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│  | **Unit tests** for `_parse_url` covering: wrong scheme, non‑whitelisted host, path‑traversal via `file://`, empty query, etc. | Guarantees the whitelist works. | `pytest` with parameterised cases. |                                                                                                                                              │
│  | **Fuzz PDF & image inputs** (e.g., AFL, `pdfFuzzer`, `libFuzzer`). | Detect crashes in `pdfminer.six` or `Pillow`. | Run inside a sandboxed VM; ensure process exits cleanly. |                                                                                                                                                                     │
│  | **OS‑level audit** – run the service with `strace -f -e tracefile=execve,open,connect,openat,clone` and verify that **no** `execve` or `open` on a path outside `/tmp` occurs when processing a malicious document. | Confirms the native OCR container is really isolated. |                                                                       │
│  | **Load test** – 100 req/s for 5 min with random documents of max size. | Verify size limit & timeout handling; ensure the service does not OOM. | Use `hey`/`locust`. |                                                                                                                                                                             │
│  | **Integration smoke test** – simulate an SSRF attempt: `http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/iam/security-credentials/role`. Expect a `PermissionError` before any HTTP request. | Prevents instance‑metadata leaks. |                                                                                                                           │
│  | **Replay attacks** – take a previously‑processed document, recompute a different hash, and send it again. Ensure the returned `sha256` still matches the stored value. | Guarantees tamper‑evidence. |                                                                                                                                              │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  ---                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  ## 6️⃣  Operational Hardening                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  1. **Run the entire service under a non‑root user** (e.g., `appuser` with UID 2000).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  │
│  2. **Deploy the OCR micro‑service in its own Docker image** with:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     │
│     * `--cap-drop=ALL`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│     * `--pids-limit=10`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                │
│     * `--memory=128m`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  │
│     * `--security-opt=no-new-privileges:true`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          │
│     * **Seccomp profile** that only allows I/O syscalls.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│  3. **Enable SELinux / AppArmor profile** for the main app that denies `execve` on any binary other than the listed interpreter (Python).                                                                                                                                                                                                              │
│  4. **Rotate TLS certificates** used by the main service in front of the public API. Enforce HSTS.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     │
│  5. **Log audit events** to a centralized immutable store (e.g., Elastic Audit Log).
