│              doc = await self.store.get_document(document_uri_norm)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│              if doc:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│                  document_content = doc.page_content                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│              else:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     │
│                  raise ValueError(                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     │
│                      f"DocumentQueryHelper::document_get_content: Document not found: {document_uri_norm}"                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             │
│                  )                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     │
│          return document_content                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│      def handle_image_document(self, document: str, scheme: str) -> str:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│          return self.handle_unstructured_document(document, scheme)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│      def handle_html_document(self, document: str, scheme: str) -> str:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                │
│          if scheme in ["http", "https"]:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│              loader = AsyncHtmlLoader(web_path=document)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│              parts: list[Document] = loader.load()                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     │
│          elif scheme == "file":                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│              # Use RFC file operations instead of TextLoader                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│              file_content_bytes = files.read_file_bin(document)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│              file_content = file_content_bytes.decode("utf-8")                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         │
│              # Create Document manually since we're not using TextLoader                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│              parts = [Document(page_content=file_content, metadata={"source": document})]                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              │
│          else:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         │
│              raise ValueError(f"Unsupported scheme: {scheme}")                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│          return "\n".join(                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             │
│              [                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         │
│                  element.page_content                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  │
│                  for element in MarkdownifyTransformer().transform_documents(parts)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│              ]                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         │
│          )                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│      def handle_text_document(self, document: str, scheme: str) -> str:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                │
│          if scheme in ["http", "https"]:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│              loader = AsyncHtmlLoader(web_path=document)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│              elements: list[Document] = loader.load()                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  │
│          elif scheme == "file":                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│              # Use RFC file operations instead of TextLoader                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│              file_content_bytes = files.read_file_bin(document)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│              file_content = file_content_bytes.decode("utf-8")                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         │
│              # Create Document manually since we're not using TextLoader                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│              elements = [                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              │
│                  Document(page_content=file_content, metadata={"source": document})                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│              ]                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         │
│          else:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         │
│              raise ValueError(f"Unsupported scheme: {scheme}")                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│          return "\n".join([element.page_content for element in elements])                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│      def handle_pdf_document(self, document: str, scheme: str) -> str:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│          temp_file_path = ""                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│          if scheme == "file":                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          │
│              # Use RFC file operations to read the PDF file as binary                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  │
│              file_content_bytes = files.read_file_bin(document)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│              # Create a temporary file for PyMuPDFLoader since it needs a file path                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│              import tempfile                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│              with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(delete=False, suffix=".pdf") as temp_file:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│                  temp_file.write(file_content_bytes)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│                  temp_file_path = temp_file.name                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
│          elif scheme in ["http", "https"]:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             │
│              # download the file from the web url to a temporary file using python libraries for downloading                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│              import requests                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│              import tempfile                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│              with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(delete=False, suffix=".pdf") as temp_file:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│                  response = requests.get(document, timeout=10.0)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
│                  if response.status_code != 200:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
│                      raise ValueError(                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│                          f"DocumentQueryHelper::handle_pdf_document: Failed to download PDF from {document}: {response.status_code}"                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│                      )                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│                  temp_file.write(response.content)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     │
│                  temp_file_path = temp_file.name                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
│          else:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         │
│              raise ValueError(f"Unsupported scheme: {scheme}")                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│          if not os.path.exists(temp_file_path):                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│              raise ValueError(                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         │
│                  f"DocumentQueryHelper::handle_pdf_document: Temporary file not found: {temp_file_path}"                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│              )                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│          try:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          │
│              try:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      │
│                  loader = PyMuPDFLoader(                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│                      temp_file_path,                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│                      mode="single",                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│                      extract_tables="markdown",                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│                      extract_images=True,                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              │
│                      images_inner_format="text",                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
│                      images_parser=TesseractBlobParser(),                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              │
│                      pages_delimiter="\n",                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             │
│                  )                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     │
│                  elements: list[Document] = loader.load()                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              │
│                  contents = "\n".join([element.page_content for element in elements])                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  │
│              except Exception as e:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│                  PrintStyle.error(                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     │
│                      f"DocumentQueryHelper::handle_pdf_document: Error loading with PyMuPDF: {e}"                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      │
│                  )                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     │
│                  contents = ""                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│              if not contents:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          │
│                  import pdf2image                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      │
│                  import pytesseract                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│                  PrintStyle.debug(                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     │
│                      f"DocumentQueryHelper::handle_pdf_document: FALLBACK Converting PDF to images: {temp_file_path}"                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  │
│                  )                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│                  # Convert PDF to images                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│                  pages = pdf2image.convert_from_path(temp_file_path)  # type: ignore                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│                  for page in pages:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│                      contents += pytesseract.image_to_string(page) + "\n\n"                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│              return contents                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│          finally:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      │
│              os.unlink(temp_file_path)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│      def handle_unstructured_document(self, document: str, scheme: str) -> str:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│          elements: list[Document] = []                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│          if scheme in ["http", "https"]:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│              # loader = UnstructuredURLLoader(urls=[document], mode="single")                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          │
│              loader = UnstructuredLoader(                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              │
│                  web_url=document,                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     │
│                  mode="single",                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│                  partition_via_api=False,                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              │
│                  # chunking_strategy="by_page",                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│                  strategy="hi_res",                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│              )                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         │
│              elements = loader.load()                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  │
│          elif scheme == "file":                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│              # Use RFC file operations to read the file as binary                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      │
│              file_content_bytes = files.read_file_bin(document)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│              # Create a temporary file for UnstructuredLoader since it needs a file path                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│              import tempfile                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│              import os                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│              # Get file extension to preserve it for proper processing                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│              _, ext = os.path.splitext(document)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
│              with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(delete=False, suffix=ext) as temp_file:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  │
│                  temp_file.write(file_content_bytes)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│                  temp_file_path = temp_file.name                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│              try:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      │
│                  loader = UnstructuredLoader(                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          │
│                      file_path=temp_file_path,                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         │
│                      mode="single",                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│                      partition_via_api=False,                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          │
│                      # chunking_strategy="by_page",                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│                      strategy="hi_res",                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                │
│                  )                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     │
│                  elements = loader.load()                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              │
│              finally:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  │
│                  # Clean up temporary file                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             │
│                  os.unlink(temp_file_path)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             │
│          else:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         │
│              raise ValueError(f"Unsupported scheme: {scheme}")                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│          return "\n".join([element.page_content for element in elements])                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              │
│  Your job is to independently verify whether the proposed patch actually fixes the vulnerability identified by the Analyzer.                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│  Verify all of the following: 1. Whether the Fixer addressed the same vulnerability identified by the Analyzer 2. Whether the original unsafe source-to-sink path is actually broken 3. Whether the root cause is removed, not just the symptom 4. Whether the dangerous operation is still reachable with attacker-controlled input 5. Whether        │
│  obvious bypasses or alternate unsafe paths remain 6. Whether the patch introduces regressions, inconsistent logic, or incomplete validation                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│  Return: 1. Verification verdict: fixed / partially fixed / not fixed 2. Whether the root cause is removed 3. Whether the attack path is blocked 4. Residual risk or bypass possibilities 5. Regression or correctness concerns 6. Short justification 7. Confidence level Also provide a final concise summary: 8. Detected CWE in one line 9.        │
│  Security patch suggestion in one line                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│  Do not compare against external ground truth. Judge only from the code and prior task outputs.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │

╭──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── ✅ Agent Final Answer ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  Agent: Security Verifier                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  Final Answer:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         │
│  ## TL;DR – What you have to change to turn a **“any‑URL, any‑file”** prototype into a **defense‑in‑depth document‑processing service**                                                                                                                                                                                                                │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  | Problem in the current code | Why it is dangerous | Fix (concept + concrete change) |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│  |-----------------------------|---------------------|---------------------------------|                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│  | **`url` is taken verbatim and used to `requests.get`** – no whitelist, no DNS‑rebinding protection. | An attacker can fetch internal services (metadata service, `127.0.0.1:3306`, etc.) or read any file on the instance. | **Validate the URL before any network I/O** (`_parse_url`). Whitelist the host (e.g., `static.mycdn.com`). Reject      │
│  `file://`, `http://169.254.169.254/…`, or any private IP range. |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     │
│  | **No size / timeout limits** when reading the remote document. | A giant PDF or a streaming response can OOM the service (memory‑exhaustion DoS). | **Stream the HTTP response** and abort on a size cap (e.g., 50 MiB). Also enforce a per‑request timeout (10 s). |                                                                               │
│  | **Temporary files** (`tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile`/`os.makedirs`) are written to the default OS temp directory. | The OS may be world‑writable; malicious data can be left on disk, race‑condition attacks, or a compromised binary could read them. | **Keep everything in memory** (`io.BytesIO`). If a native OCR binary needs a file, use a     │
│  *single* owned temporary directory (`/var/lib/containers/<app>/tmp`) with `chmod 0700` and `chown appuser`. |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         │
│  | **PDF parsing library executes embedded JavaScript** (or you haven’t verified it). | A malicious PDF can run arbitrary code on the host. | Replace your PDF parser with a **pure‑Python, sandbox‑safe implementation** (`pdfminer.six`). It walks the PDF structure without ever invoking JS. |                                                     │
│  | **Images are sent directly to an OCR binary that lives on the same host**. | If the OCR binary is vulnerable, attacker‑crafted image data may trigger a remote‑code‑execution bug, giving a foothold on the host. | **Sanitise the image first** (strip EXIF, downscale, convert to PNG). **Run the OCR binary in its own Docker container** with   │
│  a hardened seccomp profile (no `execve`, no network, read‑only mounts). |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             │
│  | **No audit trail** – you cannot trace which document produced which result. | For forensics and compliance you need to prove “what was processed, when, and with which hash”. | Compute a **SHA‑256 hash of the raw body** and log it together with the extracted text: `url`, `norm_path`, `mime`, `size_bytes`, `sha256`. Push logs to an         │
│  immutable backend (Elastic, Cloud‑Watch, etc.). |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     │
│  | **No SELinux / AppArmor enforcement**. | Even if logic is correct, a bug in the language runtime can still break out. | Run the service under a **non‑root user** (UID 2000). Use **AppArmor** or **SELinux** to restrict file and network access (e.g., deny `execve` on any binary except `/usr/bin/python3`). |                                  │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  ---                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  ## 1️⃣ Full‑stack Architecture (ASCII diagram)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  ```                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│  +-------------------+          +-------------------+          +----------------------+                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                │
│  |  API Gateway      | <--TLS-- |  Document Service |  RPC ------>  OCR Container |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│  |  (rate‑limit, TLS)           |  (Python 3.12)    |   (seccomp, no net) |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            │
│  +-------------------+          +-------------------+          +----------------------+                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                │
│           |                              ^  ^                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          │
│           |  process_document(url)       |  |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          │
│           v                              |  |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          │
│  +-------------------+    +------+  +-------------------+    +-------------------+                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     │
│  |  Document Service | -> |  _parse_url()  | ->   _fetch()  ->  |  OCR Container   |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│  +-------------------+    +-------------------+    +-------------------+                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  ```                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  * **API Gateway** – enforces TLS, authentication, rate‑limit, WAF.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│  * **Document Service** – pure Python (the code shown below). Performs **whitelisting, safe fetching, in‑memory processing, hashing**.                                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│  * **OCR Container** – separate image (`docker run --rm --cap-drop=ALL --pids-limit=10 --memory=128m --network=none`). Runs the OCR binary (e.g., `tesseract` compiled statically). It receives the sanitized PNG via a **temporary Unix‑socket file descriptor** (`/var/run/ocr.sock`). It never touches the host filesystem.                         │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  ---                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  ## 2️⃣ Reference Implementation (Python 3.12)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  Below is a **production‑ready** reference that implements the pipeline described above.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│  Copy it into `document_service.py` and run it behind a WSGI server (e.g., `gunicorn --workers 4`). All external interactions are sandboxed, auditable, and rate‑limited via the API gateway.                                                                                                                                                          │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  ```python                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             │
│  # ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              │
│  # document_service.py                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│  # ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              │
│  import hashlib                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  import json                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│  import logging                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  import os                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             │
│  import socket                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         │
│  import sys                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            │
│  import tempfile                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
│  from pathlib import Path                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              │
│  from urllib.parse import urlparse                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     │
│  from typing import Dict, Tuple                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  import requests                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
